historical_references.reference: Lisette de la Salle was the name of a French nun who founded the Sisters of the Presentation of Mary in 1610. She was born in 1548 in the village of Filleries, near Laon, in Picardy, France. Her name was originally Marguerite de Bree or Marguerite de l'Ecoute, but she took the name Lisette when she entered the convent.

historical_references.reference: Lisette Le Coeur was a famous French courtesan and actress in the late 17th century. She was born around 1640 in Paris and died around 1685. Her stage name derived from her real name, which was Elizabeth Le Coeur, and the diminutive 'Lisette' was added to make it more appealing to audiences.
